items.question: How is my metabolism calculated?
items.answer: Tazza uses scientifically-backed factors including pregnancy status, oral contraceptive use, smoking status, liver-affecting medications, and self-reported caffeine sensitivity. These factors adjust your caffeine half-life from the standard 5-hour average, giving you a truly personalized decay curve.

items.question: What's the difference between free and premium?
items.answer: The free version is generous — it includes real-time caffeine tracking, personalized metabolism, the sleep-safe countdown, the full drink library with custom drinks, Apple Watch app with complications, widgets, Live Activities, iCloud sync, and smart notifications. Premium ($6.99 one-time, no subscription) unlocks full analytics with trends, streaks, and heatmaps, sleep correlation insights via HealthKit, Shortcuts & Siri support, and CSV data export.

items.question: Does it work with Apple Watch?
items.answer: Yes! Tazza has a dedicated Apple Watch app with complications for your watch face and quick-log functionality right from your wrist — all included for free.

items.question: How does sleep integration work?
items.answer: Tazza calculates when your caffeine level drops below the sleep-safe threshold based on your personalized metabolism. It gives you a clear countdown timer so you know exactly when you're ready for restful sleep. The sleep-safe countdown is free. Premium adds deeper sleep correlation insights that analyze how your caffeine intake affects your actual sleep quality via HealthKit.

items.question: Is my data private?
items.answer: Absolutely. All your data is processed and stored entirely on your device. There are no cloud uploads, no user accounts, and no analytics tracking. If you use HealthKit integration, that data also stays local on your device per Apple's requirements.

items.question: What drinks are included?
items.answer: Tazza comes with 100+ pre-loaded drinks including various coffee types, espresso drinks, teas, energy drinks, and sodas — all with USDA-accurate caffeine values. You can also add unlimited custom drinks with your own caffeine measurements.
